name: @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace-server
description: QwzSpace — a 3D real-time graphics web engine for making browser games and rich web apps. The server-side authoritative-simulation half: a developer imports it to build their game's server. Space is a genuine icosahedral ℤ⁶→ℝ³ cut-and-project quasicrystal, time is the settling causal order, and existence/visibility is a bilattice charge (paraconsistent death = alive→⊤). The scene runs as a meme-topology settling over the geometry-agnostic web-qwzspace realtime transport, negotiating progressive render tiers (webgl → canvas2d → text) for whatever client connects. It is an engine, not a service — it claims no port and runs no daemon; the game built on it does that.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
